issue_selection: the first 7 issues of plans/s2.json's list, fixed in advance

pins.agent_source: crates/briefed-agent at 6518b03bbd (same source as c34036f3a5), built on the environment
pins.host: oa-dev-env-2 (GCE c3-standard-22 spot, 300 GB): agents, worktrees and builds on one machine (AB_HOST=local), one build checkout, prewarm per issue, incremental builds off, 600 s per command, hidden tests 300 s
pins.login: the owner's Claude Code subscription token from Secret Manager (dev-env-session.sh)

outcome: accepted = the fix commit's own tests pass on the change (remote/eval.sh: cargo exit 0 and every named test passed) AND the blind judge accepts (score >= 4). Never from the agent's own report.

analysis.comparison: each arm against B0, which runs in the same plan, on the same issues, in a balanced seeded order
analysis.primary: success difference (arm - B0) in accepted = fix's tests pass and blind judge accepts, mean over issues, 95% CI from 10000 issue-level bootstrap resamples (seed 11211); reported before cost
analysis.cost: cost per accepted from known list-price costs; the change against B0 with an issue-level bootstrap CI; unknown costs counted, never 0
analysis.decision: a lever is kept only if its success CI's lower bound is above -0.05 AND its cost per accepted is lower than B0's with the reduction CI's lower bound above 0; otherwise it is reported as not shown. No arm or issue is dropped after results.
analysis.time: median and p90 wall time per arm
analysis.tools: per tool: calls per run, share of runs, tokens in and out per call, seconds per call, acted-on rate

harness_failures: a trial that hits the login's usage limit is discarded and rerun when the login answers (no outcome was observed); nothing else is rerun or excluded.
order: issues in a seeded random order; per issue each rep rotates the arm order from a seeded start
question: Execution environment: warm build cache (prewarmed) vs cold (target dir cleared before each Bcold trial). One worker, so a cold trial never clears another trial's cache.
